findings.detail: Thirty positions sourced from the earlier comparative Schedule of Investments were retained in the 2026-03-31 holdings population.

rationale: The raw filing contains two full Schedule of Investments blocks with the same position columns. Table 15 is the current-period block and table 46 begins the parallel comparative block; for the same AlphaCoin instrument, table 15 row 5 reports 8.67% with cost/fair value (16)/(11), while table 46 row 5 reports 8.84% with cost/fair value (17)/(12). The PP03 rows are explicitly identified as facts whose source period is earlier than the 2026-03-31 report date, so retaining them in that report-date holdings population is a comparative-period extraction leak. The cited comparative row grounds the table-cohort mechanism; no valuation anchor is needed for this position-purity rule.
